title: Bake & Mystery Challenge

blocks.title: Safety first
blocks.text: Check your school’s food rules and every student’s allergies against each label, including cocoa and any mix-in. Only adults handle the oven and hot tins.

items: Book the foods room, the oven and a second adult to run it; check the oven fits every tin at once
Shop from the recipe card: one batch per team plus a spare; each batch makes 6 standard cupcakes
Each station: bowl, fork or whisk, measuring cups and spoons; one 12-cup tin with liners per two teams
Hand-washing and cleaning supplies, oven mitts, and a safe spot for hot tins
Confirm whether and when students may eat them; they will still be warm at the bell

blocks.text: Choose one Mystery twist (if running Mystery)

items.text: Only the Reader sees the recipe; everyone else works from what they hear.
The Leader gives directions but may not touch anything.
After 2 minutes of planning, no talking: pointing and gestures only.
Teams fold in one ingredient, such as chocolate chips; allergy-check it first.

items.title: Preheat
items.text: An adult switches the oven to 350°F (175°C) as the lesson begins.

items.title: Cutoff, roles and twist
items.text: Announce the pans-in time (25 min away, 30 for Mystery) and any twist. Teams wash hands and pick roles: Leader, Reader, Ingredient Manager, Mixer, Timekeeper, Clean-Up Crew; small teams double up.

items.title: Mix and fill
items.text: Teams follow the recipe and fill their liners. Circulate: dry mix done by 5 min, batter smooth by 15.

items.title: Pans in
items.text: All tins go in together. Set a 20-min timer; when it rings, the adult checks with a toothpick.
